summary: Added create-view/drop-view support for execute-write SQL. In datasette/default_actions.py, registered Action(name="create-view", abbr="cv", DatabaseResource) after create-table and Action(name="drop-view", abbr="dv", TableResource) after drop-table. In datasette/write_sql.py, added two decision cases before the alter/table case: create+view requires create-view on the database (unsupported when no database), drop+view with database and table requires drop-view on a TableResource. In datasette/utils/sql_analysis.py, renamed dropped_tables to dropped_tables_and_views and now includes drop/view keys, suppressing the spurious delete authorizer callback. In docs/authentication.rst, added both permissions to the --root list and documented both action sections with resources. All 90 tests in tests/test_queries.py pass.
